name: std::regex_traits<CharT>::value

declarations.code: int value(CharT ch, int radix) const;

intro: Determines the value represented by the digit ch in the numeric base radix, given the currently imbued locale. This function is called by std::regex when processing Quantifiers such as {1} or {2,5}, Backreferences such as \1, and hexadecimal and Unicode character escapes.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
ch

 -

 the character that may represent a digit


 radix

 -

 either 8, 10, or 16

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The numeric value if ch indeed represents a digit in the currently imbued locale that is valid for the numeric base radix, or -1 on error.
